N-001.title: New feedback received
N-001.trigger: After a customer submits complete feedback
N-001.message: Review the words and attachments against the delivery item before assessing impact.
N-001.action_target: PG-002 feedback detail; use PG-003 when confirmation is needed.

N-002.title: Lead confirmation required
N-002.trigger: After F-002 identifies scope or schedule impact
N-002.message: No additional arrangement is committed yet. Review the impact and confirm, return or defer.
N-002.action_target: PG-002 feedback detail; use PG-003 when confirmation is needed.

N-003.title: More information needed
N-003.trigger: After the lead returns a request for more information
N-003.message: Supply the delivery item and desired change. Existing input and attachments are retained for resubmission.
N-003.action_target: PG-002 feedback detail; use PG-003 when confirmation is needed.

N-004.title: Arrangement confirmed
N-004.trigger: After the lead’s decision is saved
N-004.message: Read the decision and agreed date; email delivery time is not the decision time.
N-004.action_target: PG-002 feedback detail; use PG-003 when confirmation is needed.

N-005.title: Notification needs a retry
N-005.message: The decision remains valid. Retry only this delivery without duplicating feedback or decisions.
N-005.action_target: PG-002 feedback detail; use PG-003 when confirmation is needed.

N-006.title: Deferred item needs follow-up
N-006.trigger: When the follow-up condition in BR-005 is met
N-006.message: Review the pending question and current evidence before making an explicit decision.
N-006.action_target: PG-002 feedback detail; use PG-003 when confirmation is needed.
